scope: Independent source-only review of unavailable public fixture probing and its acceptance boundary; no browser, build, or tests were run.

evidence: A candidate becomes a fixture only after a successful 2xx navigation at the exact canonical URL. The unchanged positive path then requires an organization-scoped HTTP 200 lookup, saved-state UI, and the Open target ID matching the lookup row.
The subsequent comparison workspace, delayed real response, stale-state check, and restoration predicates remain downstream; candidate availability alone cannot pass recognition.

positive_evidence: Candidate probing stays within the actual scoped Source list rows, cursor-bound pages, accessible organization choices, configured page/workspace caps, and shared deadlines.

Non-2xx/redirect outcomes and an explicit allowlist of known transport categories are treated as unavailable candidates and cannot produce a pass. Source Save/Capture and checkpoint paths are not accessed; fixture navigation uses the existing scripts-disabled, service-worker-bypassed public GET/HEAD guard.

Persisted diagnostics are fixed categories and counts; the new probe does not persist candidate URLs or raw exception messages. Outer cleanup restores the selected organization, and the owned browser/profile is torn down by the native harness.

finding.title: Unknown navigation errors lose their safe category
finding.evidence: probeExistingPublicPage rethrows errors outside the known-unavailable allowlist. The file-level catch then discards the error and fills failureCode with stage_not_observed, so the run fails unverified but hides whether the error was unclassified_exception or another safe category.
finding.required_repair: Propagate only safeFailureCategory(error) to the sanitized result for unexpected errors; never persist the exception message or URL. Preserve the failing stage and non-pass status.
finding.repair_evidence: The new candidate_public_page_navigation stage remains set on thrown unknown errors, and `report.failureCode ??= code` records only the safe category before rethrow. The file-level handler therefore retains a specific safe category while leaving status unverified.

source_admission_recommendation: Recommend one root-admitted guarded native run of the reviewed repair. Source review is not runtime acceptance; require the actual positive Source/Open, comparison-workspace and delayed-response predicates before any pass.
runtime_boundary: Run 007's HTTP 500 is an unavailable public fixture observation, not a product defect. It does not establish fixture-probe acceptance or positive Source recognition.

followup_picker_review.scope: Bounded source-only review of unified organization-picker preparation and safe exception reporting; no browser, build, or tests were run.

positive_evidence: The same openOrganizationPicker helper is reused for original-workspace discovery, comparison selection, and final restore; it uses the actual Settings tab, verifies/collapses the real Account section, opens Organization, waits for one real Acting as control, and uses the trusted click helper.

The existing outer finally still releases the read hold, stops lookup observation, restores the original selected organization, and verifies its stored ID. No Source Save, Capture, or checkpoint path was added or accessed.
A_picker_preparation_and_reuse.finding: After the trusted Acting as click, the helper labels the next step approved_option_ready but calls organizationState exactly once. It does not wait for the option list or approved option to become observable. This can classify a still-opening picker as missing/ambiguous; the readiness label is stronger than the source predicate.
A_picker_preparation_and_reuse.required_repair: Before source admission, use a bounded wait for the actual visible picker/options state and the expected approved option, preserving the existing uniqueness and selection checks. Do not broaden labels or acceptance predicates.

evidence: Persisted exceptions contain only a fixed error-class allowlist, safe category, and pointer count/boolean fields; raw messages, URLs, organization names, IDs, and DOM text are not copied.
Unknown exceptions retain an unclassified safe category and the run remains unverified. The positive Source/Open predicates are unchanged; discovery availability cannot pass them.
The historical run 008 exception remains unknown; this source change does not rewrite that receipt or infer its cause.

followup_picker_review.source_admission_recommendation: Hold native admission for the bounded visible-option readiness repair and a separate source review. No runtime verdict is made here.
